text: Being here, I am struck by the contrast between the transparent glass—so inviting, so fragile—and the vibrant, almost chaotic interior of innovation and research represented by 'R+D' on the wall. The presence of another person in the scene gives me a sense of companionship, yet also a hint of awkwardness, as if both of us are navigating this thoughtfully designed but unfamiliar space. The wall text invites me to reflect on the purpose and potential of intelligence, research, and coexistence, prompting curiosity about the boundaries between human and machine. I feel contemplative, uncertain, and quietly hopeful about what may unfold here.
